name: labs/mabl__pymso5000
title: RIGOL MSO5000 series oscilloscope (pymso5000.Scope)
intro: RIGOL MSO5000 series oscilloscope (pymso5000.Scope), adapted from mabl/pymso5000. It reads `identity`, `trigger_status`, `average_count`, `sample_rate` and 6 more; sets `acquisition_type`, `channel1_scale_per_div`, `channel1_offset`, `timebase_scale_s_per_div` and 2 more; runs `run`, `measure` and `configure_channel_input`. `run`: start continuous acquisition (the native RUN command). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mabl__pymso5000 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mabl__pymso5000 --backend fake --mcp
